verdict.rationale: The story accepts either llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, and Buzz ships agent-oriented docs that probes confirm are live. These are a root AGENTS.md contributor guide for AI agents (with CLAUDE.md pointing to it) and a vendor-shipped buzz-cli skill covering relay operations, mirrored into .agents, .claude, .codex and .goose skill folders so four agent harnesses discover them natively. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and AGENTS.md is aimed at contributors to the codebase rather than people using the product. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index of product docs, agent-oriented user docs beyond the CLI skill, and independent hands-on corroboration that agents consume these docs well.
